title: onprem-airgap-offline-bundle-vendor-rke2-ubuntu-tuf-updates
author: Asha Patel
description:
Context: Customers running Redwood Private in fully air-gapped environments have reported install/upgrade failures on Ubuntu nodes using RKE2 due to changes in upstream packaging and missing TUF metadata in our offline bundles. This PR updates the offline bundle vendoring process to include canonical TUF metadata for critical components (rke2, containerd, flannel), adds Ubuntu-specific packaging fixes, and extends the installer to validate TUF signatures during install/upgrade.

What this PR does:
- Adds TUF metadata and signature files for rke2 and containerd into the offline bundle and updates the bundle manifest generator.
- Updates the vendor script (scripts/vendor-offline-bundle.sh) to fetch upstream TUF roots and mirror them into the bundle, with retry/backoff for flaky upstream responses.
- Helm chart changes: redwood-private/helm/redwood/templates/airgap-configmap.yaml and values additions to surface vendor bundle version and tuf-root checksums.
- Installer changes: installer/bin/apply-offline-bundle now verifies TUF roots and aborts with a helpful error when verification fails. Also improves logging for airgap fetch steps.
- Terraform module change: terraform/modules/private/outputs.tf exposes vendor_bundle_version for use in automation pipelines.
- Adds an integration test (tests/airgap/tuf-signature-smoke_test.sh) that runs a minimal airgap install against a local k3s/rke2 combo on Ubuntu 22.04 VMs.

Motivation: Recent support cases (SUP-7812) showed that nodes with Ubuntu host OS encountered silent failures when package manifests changed upstream; without TUF metadata in the offline bundles, the installer could not assert content integrity. Including TUF metadata and signature verification prevents compromised or mismatched package installs and gives operators clearer failure modes during offline installs and upgrades.

Testing: Unit tests for the vendor script added; CI integration runs the airgap smoke test as a gating check. Manual validation performed against an internal QA RKE2+Ubuntu lab (see commits).

Rollout plan: Bundle generation is backward compatible; installer will perform signature verification but falls back to a non-fatal warning when run with --skip-tuf-checks (flag only intended for debug). We will roll the updated bundles to staging and coordinate with CS before prod rollouts.

Related: ENG-2894 (airgap bundle automation), ENG-2911 (installer signature verification integration).

b1e4d7f: scripts: vendor-offline-bundle.sh add tuf mirror + retry/backoff
c3f27b1: helm: expose vendor bundle version and tuf checksum in values
d4b0a55: installer: verify TUF roots during apply-offline-bundle
g7b9eaa: docs: add troubleshooting section for tuf verification failures
review_comments: Ethan Zhao: Please add exponential backoff and max attempts to the vendor script; network flakes in CI caused intermittent failures.
Asha Patel: Added backoff with jitter and bumped manifest to include rke2 checksum. Also added unit test for retry behavior.
Saira Ahmed: Installer change looks good; one nit about logging verbosity on successful verification (too chatty for normal installs).
Asha Patel: Dropped verbose logs behind DEBUG flag; default remains concise. Added a section in docs to explain debug mode.
Liam O'Connor: Ran the smoke test on Ubuntu 22.04 and confirmed installer exits non-zero on simulated TUF mismatch. Approving once CI green.
release_notes: Include TUF metadata in on-prem offline bundles; installer now verifies TUF signatures during airgap installs and upgrades. Backwards compatible with --skip-tuf-checks for debug; recommend rolling bundles to staging before production.
notes_for_ops: Bundle generator updated: regenerates offline bundle with tuf roots. CI artifact name: redwood-offline-bundle-vendor_rke2_ubuntu_20251120.tar.gz. Ops should coordinate with CS and update automation to read terraform output vendor_bundle_version.
local_testing_instructions: Run 'make build-offline-bundle' then execute './installer/bin/apply-offline-bundle --bundle ./bundle/redwood-offline-bundle-*.tar.gz' against an Ubuntu 22.04 VM. For debugging, add --skip-tuf-checks or set REDWOOD_INSTALLER_DEBUG=1.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: New signature verification can cause installs to fail if bundles are incomplete. Mitigation: installer supports --skip-tuf-checks for emergency installs; bundle generation validated in staging and CI integration test added.
changelog_entry: On-prem: Airgap bundles now include TUF metadata and installer verifies signatures (supports --skip-tuf-checks).
audit_trail: Merged by Ethan Zhao after approvals from Saira Ahmed and Liam O'Connor. CI passed all gates including integration airgap smoke test. Backported small fix to vendor script in follow-up commit before merge.
